thread:
Morgan: Quick heads-up — HyperLane sent an SLA/options email for the H100 top-off. Two lanes: standard sea (12-16w) or express air (3-5w). Air is ~+27% on unit price. They also offered a reserved RMA kit pool at FRA depot for faster swaps. Uploaded PO/manifest to the drive.

Sanjay: Do we actually have staging capacity in eu-west-1 to absorb a 48-unit air arrival? cluster queues are already stacked.

Kevin: eu-west has ~30% free on Dedicated pools in early May if we drain noncritical batch jobs. Network staging (transfer window to racks) is the risky piece — depot handoff windows matter.

Amira (HyperLane): We can do a split shipment (60% sea / 40% air) to hit both cost and lead-time targets. FRA depot can hold express RMA kits with a 48-72h swap SLA; requires deposit and signed addendum. We can also pre-assign serial blocks for faster processing.

Rachel: Cost quick-check: Air-only delta ~+$450k total. Split (72 sea / 48 air) ~+$180k + depot fees (~$12k/month hold). Need CFO sign-off but looks reasonable vs outage risk.

Morgan: My leaning is split to hedge. Proposal: reserve 8-unit canary via air to eu-west, rest split. Ops: can you provision canary and confirm window? Also need to confirm RMA flow for DOA — will depot swap or forward replacements?

Sanjay: I can carve out 8 canary nodes in 10-14 days if we pre-approve routing and provide AWB + serial list. For rest, sea arrival will hit AMS staging; that adds ~5 business days for customs + kitting.

Amira (HyperLane): We will send a proforma AWB and a serial block file by EOD. RMA note: depot can perform immediate swap for units under warranty if SLA addendum signed. For DOA outside depot window, we do courier replacement (longer).

Kevin: If routing through FRA, remember customs: HS code 8471 often ok but some carriers want extra docs. Ops-bot, please add reminder to procurement checklist.

ops-bot: Reminder added: "attach HS certificate + proof of purchase for FRA routing" (auto).

Morgan: I'll loop Legal for the SLA addendum and Ops for the temporary burst quota on Dedicated pool during roll-in (72h). Also, please attach PO snippet in thread:

```
PO: PO-98432
qty: 120 H100
split: 72 sea / 48 air
ETA-air-canary: ~3-5w
ETA-sea-bulk: ~12-16w
RMA-depot-hold: FRA, 20 kits for 90d (requires SLA addendum)
```

Rachel: Sounds good. I'll finalize the cost memo and run a quick unit-economics + SLA risk table.

Amira (HyperLane): Sending AWB + serial CSV in DM and will post manifest link here once uploaded. If you want earlier depot hold, we can quote a prepaid hold fee.

Sanjay: Once we have AWB + serials, I'll prep the canary build plan and network handoff window.

Morgan: Great. Action items: 1) Amira to share AWB/serials (EOD) 2) Legal to review SLA addendum 3) Ops to prep canary (10-14d) and request transient burst quota. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
